name: 72632 · Eureka Spgs, AR
findings: ZIP 72632 (Eureka Spgs) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72632 (Eureka Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 72632 (Eureka Spgs) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
